They are actively chatting with each other and laughing: one tells a story with a relaxed hand gesture, another laughs and leans slightly forward, the other two smile and engage naturally with the group. They look at each other, not at the viewer. All four faces and seated figures are visually distinct and readable. Make this a warm spontaneous shared moment, not four posed people.
Behind the group stands a charming cream-and-pale-turquoise CAMPER / motorhome, naturally integrated into the campsite. It is motorized, not a towable caravan. A few small warm string lights above the right-hand campsite echo the photograph. Late golden hour moving into early dusk, with enough ambient light to see every person and the camper clearly; soft warm campfire light, quiet blue and sage landscape shadows, no black nighttime background. Casual muted teal, terracotta, cream and sage outdoor clothing, adult proportions, natural anatomy.
Composition/framing: the four friends, fire, chairs and camper form a single coherent vignette wholly in the RIGHTMOST 37% of the panorama, around x=63%-98%. Friends' heads around y=45%-56%, chair feet around y=82%-88%, fire around x=81%, y=76%. Camper behind them within x=67%-97%, y=30%-72%. Leave comfortable margins around the entire group and vehicle so all four people remain visible after a mobile cover crop. Keep the LEFT 60% a calm uninterrupted meadow and softly layered forested hills with very low detail for a future text overlay. No people, campfire, camper, lights or foreground objects in that left text area.
Style/medium: match the app's watercolor references closely — fine visible watercolor paper grain, gently layered pigments, delicate organic brushwork, painterly foliage, natural proportions, sage and pine greens, soft blue mountains, pale turquoise and cream, restrained amber warmth. One continuous painting, no detached clip-art.
Constraints: exactly four adults in total, seated together; no children or standing people. No additional vehicles, tents or trailer. No typography, lettering, logos, number plates, UI, badges, icons, borders, buttons, watermarks or baked-in text gradients. No photography, glossy 3D, plastic cartoon or vector-art aesthetic.
